# Generated prose that aggregates a series instead of reading a value the notebook bound.
#
# `rules/notebook-standards.md` requires that every number a notebook shows equals the number
# it just computed. A sentence built as `f"{returns.mean():.2%}"` produces a statistic nothing
# else in the notebook holds, so the figure above it cannot be checked against the sentence
# below it, and editing the figure's own computation moves one and not the other.
#
# These sites are listed rather than fixed because the fix is a code-cell change - bind the
# value before the `display()` - which makes the notebook stale and costs a full re-execution.
# Listing them gates the rule against NEW ones at no re-execution cost.
#
# HOW TO USE THIS FILE: when you re-execute one of these notebooks for any reason, bind the
# value first and delete its line here. The list may only ever shrink. The checker fails on a
# site that is not listed, so a new one cannot arrive quietly, and it fails on a listed site
# that is no longer there, so a stale line cannot sit here unnoticed.
#
# Format: the notebook source, a tab, and the expression as `ast.unparse` writes it. The
# expression rather than a line number, so a re-executed notebook whose cells moved does not
# invalidate every line.
